infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: IndoFleet Delivery App needs location access to track real-time delivery telemetry.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: IndoFleet Delivery App requires continuous background GPS to sync delivery tracking with Command Center.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: IndoFleet Delivery App needs camera access to capture Proof of Delivery (POD) handover photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: IndoFleet Delivery App needs photo library access to upload Proof of Delivery (POD) handover images.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow IndoFleet Delivery App to use your location for real-time delivery navigation and flight tracking.

plugins.photosPermission: IndoFleet Delivery App needs access to your photos to upload Proof of Delivery photos.
plugins.cameraPermission: IndoFleet Delivery App needs access to your camera to capture Proof of Delivery photos.
